combo_label: Picnics × The Blacksmith's Forge × The Domesday Book

entries.clue: Early low hearth where ore was reduced without ever running liquid
Quarter of a hide, a common holding for a peasant family
Worthless stony waste that floats on the metal and heaps up beside old mines
Bundle of folded sheets, several of them making up the volume
Dunk a red-hot bar in the water tub to set the metal hard
Breadcrumb-coated snack ball with a hard-boiled heart
Iced sponge sliced up and passed along — a doddle, idiomatically
Crescent the smith bends to fit, then burns onto the foot to try it
Franchise of holding a local court and pocketing its profits
Hard yellow wedge eaten with an onion — and said for photographs
